name: promotion-control-ui
description: Splunk UI Toolkit page for the promotion_control app

scripts.package: npm run build && cd .. && mkdir -p dist && COPYFILE_DISABLE=1 tar --no-xattrs -czf dist/promotion_control-$npm_package_version.spl promotion_control
scripts.harness: mkdir -p dev/out && cp dev/index.html dev/out/ && HARNESS_OUT=$PWD/dev/out webpack --config dev/webpack.harness.js && echo 'Serve ui/dev/out (e.g. python3 -m http.server -d dev/out) and open /?scheme=dark'
